sets.title: Sales of two-wheelers and cars by a dealer (in hundreds)
Runs scored by two batters in eight matches (in runs)
Retail price of rice and wheat per kg (in ₹)
Online and showroom sales of a mobile brand (in thousand units)
Wickets taken by two bowlers per series (in number)

questions.questionText: By how much does the sales figure of Two-wheelers differ from that of Cars in 2021 (in hundreds)?
questions.explanation: 2021: Two-wheelers = 110, Cars = 132. Difference = 22.

questions.questionText: What was the sales figure of Two-wheelers in 2023 (in hundreds)?
questions.explanation: Read the Two-wheelers line at 2023: 114 hundreds.

questions.questionText: In which year was the gap between the sales figure of Two-wheelers and Cars the smallest?
For how many years was the sales figure of Two-wheelers greater than that of Cars?
questions.explanation: Two-wheelers > Cars in 4 of the 8 years.

questions.questionText: In the year in which the two lines are closest to each other, what is the combined sales figure of Two-wheelers and Cars (in hundreds)?
In which match did the run tally of Kohli first exceed that of Rohit?
questions.explanation: Kohli starts below Rohit. Comparing point by point, it first goes above in M2 (72 vs 40).

questions.questionText: By how much does the run tally of Kohli differ from that of Rohit in M2 (in runs)?
questions.explanation: M2: Kohli = 72, Rohit = 40. Difference = 32.

questions.questionText: The line of Kohli and the line of Rohit intersect for the first time between which two consecutive matches?
questions.explanation: Gap (Kohli - Rohit) changes sign from -15 in M1 to 32 in M2, so the lines cross in between.
questions.shortcut: A crossover happens where the sign of the difference between the two values flips.

questions.questionText: How many times do the lines of Kohli and Rohit cross each other over the period shown?
questions.explanation: Gap (Kohli - Rohit) by match: -15, 32, -25, 18, -21, -28, 43, -16. The sign changes 6 time(s).
questions.shortcut: Count the number of sign changes in the difference.

questions.questionText: In the match in which the gap between the two lines is the largest, by what percent is the higher value above the lower? (Correct to one decimal place.)
questions.explanation: Widest gap is 43 in M7 (95 vs 52). Percent = 43/52 x 100 = 82.7%.

questions.questionText: By how much does the price of Rice differ from that of Wheat in May (in ₹ per kg)?
questions.explanation: May: Rice = 50, Wheat = 55. Difference = 5.

questions.questionText: What was the price of Wheat in Feb (in ₹ per kg)?
questions.explanation: Read the Wheat line at Feb: 41 ₹ per kg.

questions.questionText: How many times do the lines of Rice and Wheat cross each other over the period shown?
questions.explanation: Gap (Rice - Wheat) by month: 6, 5, 4, 1, -5, -11, -12. The sign changes 1 time(s).
questions.shortcut: Count the number of sign changes in the difference.

questions.questionText: In which month was the gap between the price of Rice and Wheat the smallest?
questions.explanation: Gaps: Jan: 6, Feb: 5, Mar: 4, Apr: 1, May: 5, Jun: 11, Jul: 12. Smallest is 1 in Apr.

questions.questionText: Considering only the months in which Rice was above Wheat, what is the average gap (Rice minus Wheat) (in ₹ per kg)? (Correct to one decimal place.)
questions.explanation: Gaps in those months: 6, 5, 4, 1. Average = 16/4 = 4.0.

questions.questionText: In which year did the sales figure of Online first exceed that of Showroom?
questions.explanation: Online starts below Showroom. Comparing point by point, it first goes above in 2021 (80 vs 70).

questions.questionText: In which year was the gap between the sales figure of Online and Showroom the smallest?
For how many years was the sales figure of Online greater than that of Showroom?
questions.explanation: Online > Showroom in 3 of the 7 years.

questions.questionText: The line of Online and the line of Showroom intersect for the first time between which two consecutive years?
questions.explanation: Gap (Online - Showroom) changes sign from -14 in 2020 to 10 in 2021, so the lines cross in between.
questions.shortcut: A crossover happens where the sign of the difference between the two values flips.

questions.questionText: Taking only the years in which Online was above Showroom, what is the total of the gaps (Online minus Showroom) (in thousand units)?
questions.explanation: Gaps where Online is higher: 10, 32, 55. Total = 97.

questions.questionText: By how much does the population of Town X differ from that of Town Y in 2010 (in thousand)?
questions.explanation: 2010: Town X = 105, Town Y = 72. Difference = 33.

questions.questionText: In which year did the population of Town Y first exceed that of Town X?
questions.explanation: Town Y starts below Town X. Comparing point by point, it first goes above in 2025 (126 vs 117).

questions.questionText: The line of Town X and the line of Town Y intersect for the first time between which two consecutive years?
questions.explanation: Gap (Town X - Town Y) changes sign from 6 in 2020 to -9 in 2025, so the lines cross in between.
questions.shortcut: A crossover happens where the sign of the difference between the two values flips.

questions.questionText: How many times do the lines of Town X and Town Y cross each other over the period shown?
questions.explanation: Gap (Town X - Town Y) by year: 50, 43, 33, 20, 6, -9, -25, -40. The sign changes 1 time(s).
questions.shortcut: Count the number of sign changes in the difference.

questions.questionText: What is the average of the combined population of Town X and Town Y over only those years in which Town X exceeded Town Y (in thousand)? (Correct to one decimal place.)
questions.explanation: Qualifying years: 2000, 2005, 2010, 2015, 2020. Combined values: 130, 153, 177, 200, 222. Average = 176.4.

questions.questionText: In which series did the wicket tally of Bumrah first exceed that of Ashwin?
questions.explanation: Bumrah starts below Ashwin. Comparing point by point, it first goes above in S2 (18 vs 14).

questions.questionText: How many times do the lines of Bumrah and Ashwin cross each other over the period shown?
questions.explanation: Gap (Bumrah - Ashwin) by series: -4, 4, -4, 4, -7, 4, -3. The sign changes 6 time(s).
questions.shortcut: Count the number of sign changes in the difference.

questions.questionText: In which series was the gap between the wicket tally of Bumrah and Ashwin the smallest?
questions.explanation: Gaps: S1: 4, S2: 4, S3: 4, S4: 4, S5: 7, S6: 4, S7: 3. Smallest is 3 in S7.

questions.questionText: For how many series was the wicket tally of Bumrah greater than that of Ashwin?
questions.explanation: Bumrah > Ashwin in 3 of the 7 series.

questions.questionText: In the series in which the two lines are closest to each other, what is the combined wicket tally of Bumrah and Ashwin (in wickets)?
questions.explanation: Gaps: 4, 4, 4, 4, 7, 4, 3. Closest is S7 (gap 3). Combined = 20 + 23 = 43.
